messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: ur5e-manual, p. 46

6. Assembly and Mounting 6.4. Workspace and Operating Space Description The workspace is the range of the fully extended robot arm, horizontally and vertically. The operating space is the location where the robot is expected to function. NOTICE Disregard for the robot workspace and operating space can result in the damage to property. It is important to consider the cylindrical volume directly above and directly below the robot base when choosing location to mount the robot. Moving the tool close to the cylindrical volume should be avoided because it causes the joints to move fast even when the tool is moving slowly. This can cause the robot to work inefficiently and can make it difficult to conduct a risk assessment. Copyright © 2009–2025 by Universal Robots A/S. All rights reserved. NOTICE Moving the tool close to the cylindrical volume can cause the joints to move too fast, leading to loss of functionality and damage to property. • Do not move the tool close to the cylindrical volume, even when the tool is moving slowly. Workspace The cylindrical volume is both directly above and directly below the robot base. The robot extends 850 mm from the base joint. Front Tilted UR5e 49 User Manual
